items.question: What service credit applies to downtime, and what monthly fee is it calculated on?
items.answer:
The service credit applies to downtime as follows: for each full hour of unavailability below the 99.5% availability level, the client receives a service credit of five percent (5%) of the monthly subscription fee [1].

The monthly fee on which the service credit is calculated is USD 18,500 per month for the Harrowgate platform [2].

Service credits in any calendar month are capped at twenty-five percent (25%) of the monthly subscription fee for that month [1].

Client shall pay a platform subscription fee of USD 18,500 per month for the Harrowgate platform.
Service credits in any calendar month are capped at twenty-five percent (25%) of the monthly subscription fee for that month.

items.question: How much notice is needed to terminate the Kestrel storage agreement?
items.answer:
The Kestrel storage agreement specifies that either party may terminate the agreement on sixty (60) days' written notice [1].

There is no other provision in the Kestrel storage agreement that addresses termination notice periods. The other documents referenced are secondary and relate to a different agreement, the Harrowgate MSA, which is not the subject of this question.
